messages:
olivia: Heads-up from today's console accessibility sweep: Filter flyout -> Tags list is double-reading the chip label on VoiceOver and sometimes keyboard focus lands on the invisible overlay. Quick repro: Dashboard > Filters > open > Tab to tag list > ArrowDown.
marco: ouch. Do we know if it's the chip element announcing itself plus the live region pinging?
tina: I grabbed a short console log while reproducing: 
```
flyout: opened
virtual-list: render window [8..23]
aria-live: "Tags loaded"
focus: moved to #tag-chip-9
aria-live: "Tag: security"
aria-live: "Tag: security"
```
olivia: looks like both the container live region and the focused element are announcing. Also the overlay has tabindex=0 so when the list re-renders focus falls back to overlay for a moment and SR reads nothing useful.
marco: simple fixes: (1) remove aria-live from the item container and issue a single polite message like "20 tags loaded"; (2) set overlay tabindex to -1 so it doesn't receive focus; (3) preserve focus by mapping a stable data-focus-key on chips and restoring focus to the matching DOM node after virtualization.
tina: agreed. Also spotted a missing :focus-visible style on compact chips in dark mode — the ring is 1px and barely visible. Need 2px with token-based color that meets 3:1.
a11y-bot: Automated results: aria-live-usage=FAIL; duplicate-announcements=1; focusable-overlay=1; focus-visible-missing=1; contrast-warnings=0
olivia: plan: marco takes (1) and (2), tina takes focus ring CSS and snapshot tests, I'll implement the data-focus-key util + unit test to simulate a reflowed virtual list. Can we also add an integration QA checklist?
marco: I'll open a small PR with the aria-live change and overlay tabindex fix. Will include code comment explaining NVDA quirks.
tina: will add CSS vars and update the visual regression snapshots for compact chips.
olivia: QA checklist for the ticket RT-4721: 
- macOS VoiceOver: open filters, navigate chips with arrow keys and Tab; ensure single announcement and focus stays on chip
- Windows NVDA: same flow
- Keyboard-only: open/close flyout with Enter/Esc and ensure focus returns to filter button
- Mobile Safari: open flyout, rotate screen, verify focus doesn't jump unexpectedly
a11y-bot: RT-4721 created. Priority: medium.
olivia: aiming for PRs by Thursday EOD, will attach the VoiceOver capture and the console trace. Thanks all :thumbsup:
